name: fs-product-catalog
description: Build tools for FluxStack Product Catalog plugin

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:frontend && npm run build:css:admin
scripts.build:css:frontend: cat assets/css/frontend-common.css assets/css/frontend-archive.css assets/css/frontend-single.css | cleancss -o assets/dist/frontend.min.css
scripts.build:js: npm run build:js:frontend && npm run build:js:admin
scripts.build:js:frontend: cat assets/js/frontend-common.js assets/js/frontend-archive.js assets/js/frontend-single.js | terser -o assets/dist/frontend.min.js -c -m
